name: Ōtake (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Ōtake city emblem in white: a ring of four segments with pointed ends, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ōtake, a city in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 December 1954.

features.role: Ōtake city emblem — a ring of four segments with pointed ends, like a stylised character
